nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠Human metapneumovirus (#HMPV) cases have surged across northern Chinese provinces this winter, particularly among children. 
#hMPV #outbreak @CDCgov #China #EU

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠The European Union is closely monitoring the situation, with the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (#ECDC) collaborating with #Chinese health authorities and the World Health Organization (#WHO) to gather more information.
#hMPV #outbreak @CDCgov #China #eupwr

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠Images of crowded hospitals in #China have sparked concerns on social media, with comparisons to the early days of #COVID-19. Indonesia has also heightened precautions, introducing health monitoring measures for travelers from China and #Malaysia, including a pre-arrival health record form for those visiting #Bali.
#hMPV #outbreak @CDCgov #China #EU

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠While the #ECDC notes that HMPV cases in #Europe remain typical for the season, heightened global surveillance reflects growing concern about the outbreak in #China and its regional impact. 
Authorities worldwide are emphasizing vigilance and preparedness.
#hMPV #outbreak
